runs.content: Investar Holding (ISTR) picked up at the previous close ($29.32) — a Louisiana community bank trading at ~13x trailing / ~9.3x forward P/E and ~1.2x book value despite double-digit revenue and earnings growth. Exits today: LHA (Lufthansa) hit the 60-day max-hold limit and closed for a blended +18.2% (+$182), the portfolio's largest closed win; CMCSA dropped to −9.50% on a high-volume selloff and is now within $1.33 of its stop.

RTX Corporation picked up at the previous close ($194.88) after a blowout Q2 print — EPS and revenue beat consensus by double digits, FY26 guidance raised on both lines, and backlog hit a record $289B; the ~5% pop is far smaller than sector-mate Lockheed Martin's ~10% move on its own beat-and-raise today, and RTX already carries a Morningstar wide-moat, undervalued flag. No exits today: all 26 legacy positions repriced with no new stop-loss, T1, or T2 triggers, though GEV reversed sharply from +11.25% to +1.58% on AI-infrastructure payback jitters, and LHA is now 59 days held — 1 day from the 60-day max-hold limit.
